Milk is a perishable food. USDA says your fridge keeps food safe for up to 4 hours after the power goes out, as long as you keep the door closed as much as you can. After 4 hours without power, discard milk and other perishables like meat, eggs, and leftovers. Never taste food to check if it is safe. When in doubt, throw it out.
